findings.reproduction: In the new approved demo controls, pause the gallery, then press Replace images. Both sets contain six images. Before the fix, all six replacement img style.transform values were empty; orbit images piled at the origin and spiral cards piled at the center.
findings.expected: New images retain their computed orbit/spiral positions even when count stays the same and motion is paused.
findings.rootCause: Effects captured the image nodes but depended only on count and motion options. React remounted src-keyed orbit images or id-keyed spiral cards while the effect retained removed nodes.
findings.fix: Track rendered source identities in OrbitImages and item IDs/order in InfiniteSpiral effect dependencies. Added Replace images controls in the two approved public examples.
verification: Pre-fix CUA assertions failed with six empty transforms for each paused gallery.
Post-fix CUA reads confirmed data-running=false and six distinct non-empty transforms after same-count replacement.
Scoped ESLint passed for both leaves and examples.
findings.remainingLimits: The persistent combined browser runner is added; first combined CUA run timed out navigating to orbit-images before assertions. Equivalent individual reproduction/fix checks passed. Mobile, every variant, and long-duration cycles remain pending.

findings.reproduction: Pause effect, open Colour and contrast, change Paper to Grove. Before fix, computed --v-pink changed from #F0A4CC to #E4A8B2 but canvas data URL stayed byte-identical with data-running=false.
findings.expected: Paused effects repaint changed colors without restarting or resetting their motion.
findings.rootCause: ReferenceField only observed root class/data-mode. AppearanceProvider updates inline tokens and emits cojeev:appearancechange, which the field did not handle.
findings.fix: Subscribe to appearance changes and observe actual ancestor theme/style attributes. A color-signature guard invalidates/repaints only changed colors, separately from resizing, and cleanup removes the listener.
verification: Pre-fix live CUA assertion confirmed unchanged canvas after a real palette change.
After fix, paused canvas changed for the applied palette and data-running remained false.
Original Paper palette restored after verification.
findings.remainingLimits: Live palette proof uses MagicRings; nine wrappers share the repaired engine. Distinct artwork algorithms, nested custom theme combinations and all variants have not each been visually rechecked.
